Priya (CS Ops): Heads-up: Playbook 'onboard-complete->health-bump' fired twice for a set of accounts this morning. Seeing +2 health increments on ~30 accounts.
Jules (CS Manager): Oof. Any pattern on which accounts? enterprise vs startup?
Priya (CS Ops): Mostly trial->paid flows. Example acct ACCT-9982 shows two events within 30s. Link: https://our-cs/acct/ACCT-9982.
Ethan (Platform): Automation logs show two webhook deliveries for the same external_event_id. We should have an at-least-once guard by event id. Looks like the dedupe cache evicted earlier than expected.
Ravi (SRE): Current cache TTL is 20s. If the webhook retries happened after 25s, they'd reprocess. That TTL was tuned for throughput, not correctness.
Priya (CS Ops): We rely on single health bump per external_event_id. If reprocessed, it applies again. Need safe dedupe in playbook runner.
Ethan (Platform): Proposal: add idempotency store write-before-run. Pseudo: 
```
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
if not exists (select 1 from idempotency where key = event_id) then
  insert into idempotency(key, created_at) values (event_id, now());
  run_playbook();
end;
COMMIT;
```
Ravi (SRE): That will solve it. But we need a migration: un-double the health for affected accounts. We can compute duplicates by grouping events. SQL: 
```
select external_event_id, count(*) as c from playbook_runs where playbook = 'onboard-health-bump' and created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by external_event_id having count(*) > 1;
```
Priya (CS Ops): Can you run that and share list? I can vet which ones are non-legit.
Ethan (Platform): Running now in staging query returns 34 duplicate event_ids. I'll run in prod as read-only and paste results.
automation-bot: automation-bot: playbook-run attempt 2024-07-14T09:12:03Z status=success
Ravi (SRE): Prod read-only results: 31 duplicate keys. I exported CSV and dropped it in /tmp/dup-events-20240714.csv.
Jules (CS Manager): We should correct live health metric. Priya, what's the impact on renewal risk?
Priya (CS Ops): Small per-account but aggregate +0.08 health bias across cohort. Could mask early churn signals. Need correction.
Ethan (Platform): Plan: 1) implement idempotency write in playbook runner (staging patch today) 2) one-off backfill job to decrement duplicate extra bumps, flagged migration:true 3) tag all corrected accounts with cs_fix:playbook_dedupe and a short TTL.
Ravi (SRE): I'll own the backfill job. Dry-run will list (account_id, duplicate_count, corrective_delta). We'll not touch anything until CS Ops signs off.
Priya (CS Ops): Please schedule dry-run and post results. Also add monitoring alert if idempotency store evictions > 1/min after deploy.
Ethan (Platform): On it. Pushed staging change (rev d9f2). Deploy to prod after a 30m soak.
automation-bot: automation-bot: staging deploy rev d9f2 at 2024-07-14T10:02Z :white_check_mark:
Ravi (SRE): Dry-run output: 31 rows, total overcount = 31 extra bumps. I put sample in ops-convoy. No unexpected account churn.
Priya (CS Ops): Approve. Schedule prod backfill at 14:00 PT. Please ensure migration:true tag and cs_fix:playbook_dedupe on changed accounts.
Jules (CS Manager): Good catch. Also add a note to the playbook runbook: require idempotency write and owner review for any playbook that mutates healthscore.
Ethan (Platform): Will update runbook and open PR for prod idempotency (https://our-repo/pr/421).
Priya (CS Ops): Thanks team. After run, I'll snapshot healthscore baseline and confirm delta removal in ops doc. :thumbsup:
